shorts.hook: This fungus is linked to ninety presumed-extinct frog species.
shorts.title: This Fungus Is Deleting Entire Species of Frog
shorts.outro: Then Doug goes for a swim. The full dive is linked below.
shorts.description: A 2019 study linked the chytrid skin fungus to the decline of at least 501 amphibian species, and 90 of them are now presumed extinct.

shorts.hook: An earthquake once shook a fungus loose onto a whole county.
shorts.title: The Earthquake That Shook a Fungus Into a Whole County
shorts.outro: What happens next is even worse. The full dive is linked below.
shorts.description: The 1994 Northridge earthquake set off landslides whose dust carried valley fever spores into Ventura County, which recorded 203 cases in eight weeks, about ten times the normal number.

shorts.hook: Most fungi can't survive your body heat. This one might.
shorts.title: Most Fungi Can't Grow at Body Heat. This One Can
shorts.outro: Then Doug turns up his thermostat. The full dive is linked below.
shorts.description: Our body temperature keeps out most fungi, but Candida auris grew well at 40 degrees Celsius when it was first described, and one hypothesis says a warming climate taught it how.
